page.performance.title: Performance
page.performance.subtitle: Monitor your PC live and check the settings that can improve your Roblox performance.
page.performance.overlay_drag_hint: Drag the overlay directly on screen to reposition it.
page.performance.optimize_desc_roblox: Fixes improvable Windows settings (Game Mode, power plan, Xbox Game Bar, SysMain...) and recommends the best Fast Flags preset.
page.performance.optimize_desc_generic: Fixes improvable Windows settings (Game Mode, power plan, Xbox Game Bar, SysMain...).
page.performance.optimize_confirm_text: This will apply, all at once, every improvable Windows setting detected below (power plan, Game Mode, Xbox Game Bar/DVR, SysMain service as needed) — some may trigger an elevation (UAC) prompt.
page.performance.fix_confirm_power_plan: This fix will run powercfg to switch your PC to the Windows "High performance" power plan.
page.performance.fix_confirm_game_mode: This fix will modify the Windows registry (HKCU\Software\Microsoft\GameBar) to enable Game Mode.
page.performance.fix_confirm_game_dvr: This fix will modify the Windows registry (HKCU\System\GameConfigStore) to disable Xbox Game Bar / DVR.
page.performance.fix_confirm_sysmain: This fix will stop and disable the Windows SysMain (Superfetch) service — an elevation (UAC) prompt will appear.
page.performance.optimize_preset_line: Recommended Fast Flags preset: {preset} — activate it from the Fast Flags page.
page.performance.optimize_none_needed: No automatic action needed: the detected settings are already correct.
page.performance.no_improvements: No improvements detected: everything is already optimal.
page.performance.config_gpu_driver_note: We can't confirm whether this driver is up to date without checking the manufacturer's website — verify manually if unsure.
page.performance.auto_fix_success: Fixed. The diagnostic will run again.
page.performance.auto_fix_failure: Automatic fix failed. Try the manual steps above.
performance.bottleneck.none: No component seems to be a particular bottleneck right now.
performance.bottleneck.ram_low_total: With only {total} GB of RAM, it's the RAM that caps your performance before the CPU or GPU even come into play.
performance.bottleneck.ram_high_usage: Your RAM is running at {percent}% continuously, which can slow down Roblox and Windows.
performance.bottleneck.cpu_high_usage: Your CPU is averaging {percent}% usage — it's limiting your performance before the GPU or RAM.
performance.bottleneck.cpu_low_cores: With only {cores} cores, your CPU may struggle to keep up with Roblox and Windows at the same time.
performance.bottleneck.gpu_high_usage: Your graphics card is averaging {percent}% usage — it's capping your performance before the CPU or RAM.
performance.bottleneck.disk_critical_spa: Only {free_gb} GB of free space left: this can cause slowdowns and block Roblox updates.
performance.bottleneck.disk_low_space: Free disk space is getting tight ({free_gb} GB): consider freeing up some room.
performance.card.power_plan.title: Power plan
performance.card.power_plan.desc_unknown: Could not determine the current power plan.
performance.card.power_plan.desc_ok: The "High performance" plan is active: that's the best setting for gaming.
performance.card.power_plan.desc_warning: The active plan is "{name}": switching to High performance can improve in-game smoothness.
performance.card.power_plan.fix_steps: Windows > Settings > System > Power > Power mode, choose "Best performance" (or click the button below to do it automatically).
performance.card.game_mode.title: Windows Game Mode
performance.card.game_mode.desc_ok: Game Mode is enabled: Windows prioritizes resources for the foreground game.
performance.card.game_mode.desc_warning: Game Mode is disabled: enabling it can reduce interruptions while you play.
performance.card.game_mode.fix_steps: Windows > Settings > Gaming > Game Mode, turn the switch on (or click the button below to do it automatically).
performance.card.game_dvr.title: Xbox Game Bar / background recording
performance.card.game_dvr.desc_ok: Background recording is disabled: nothing is using resources unnecessarily.
performance.card.game_dvr.desc_warning: Background recording (Xbox Game Bar) is active: disabling it frees up some CPU/GPU while gaming.
performance.card.game_dvr.fix_steps: Windows > Settings > Gaming > Captures, turn off "Record clips" (or click the button below to do it automatically).
performance.card.sysmain.title: SysMain (Superfetch) service
performance.card.sysmain.desc_ok: The SysMain service is stopped: no background disk activity from it.
performance.card.sysmain.desc_warning: The SysMain (Superfetch) service is running in the background: it can slow down mechanical drives (HDD). Less impact on SSDs.
performance.card.disk_space.title: Disk space
performance.card.disk_space.desc_warning: {free_gb} GB free ({percent}%): consider freeing up space to avoid slowdowns.
performance.card.disk_space.desc_critica: Only {free_gb} GB free ({percent}%): free up space soon, this can block Roblox updates.
performance.card.ram_total.title: Memory (RAM)
performance.card.ram_total.desc_ok: {total} GB of RAM: enough for Blox Fruits and Windows at the same time.
performance.card.ram_total.desc_warning: {total} GB of RAM is a bit tight for Roblox + Windows together: close unused background apps.

performance.card.roblox.desc_missing: Roblox was not found on this PC.
page.fastflags.title: Fast Flags
page.fastflags.placeholder: Optimize Roblox with safe, official Fast Flags.
page.fastflags.kill_switch_confirm_text: Enabling this setting registers this app as the handler for the roblox-player:// protocol in the Windows registry (HKCU\Software\Classes), to intercept Roblox launches and re-inject your Fast Flags into ClientAppSettings.json on every launch.
page.fastflags.launch_success: Roblox was launched with this Fast Flags configuration.
page.fastflags.launch_injection_failed_w: Roblox was launched, but applying the Fast Flags failed.
page.fastflags.roblox_not_found_error: Couldn't find Roblox on this computer.
page.fastflags.apply_error: Couldn't write the Roblox configuration file. Make sure Roblox is closed and try again.
page.fastflags.reset_success: Default settings restored. Restart Roblox for it to take effect.
page.fastflags.import_error: Invalid file: content must be a JSON object of flags (name -> value).
page.risk.disabled_text: Risk analysis is disabled: nothing is calculated. Turn on the switch above to see an estimate.
page.risk.disclaimer: Calculated locally from your current settings (nothing is sent to Roblox or anyone else). This is neither a guarantee nor an official figure.
page.risk.no_contributors: No risk factor currently detected: no custom Fast Flags preset active, and the macro engine isn't implemented yet (nothing to evaluate there for now).
risk.contributor.fastflags_custom: A custom Fast Flags preset (not verified by the community) is active.
risk.contributor.fastflags_preset: A provided Fast Flags preset (graphics/perf only) is active — minimal impact.
risk.recommendation.fastflags_custom: Switch back to a provided preset (Hard/Balanced/Quality) to use flags already verified by the community.

page.custom_script.title: Custom Script
page.custom_script.subtitle: Import or paste an AutoHotkey v2 script, analyze it, then turn it on to launch it without the app's administrator rights.
page.custom_script.import_error_binary: This file doesn't look like a valid AutoHotkey text script (binary content detected).
page.custom_script.save_empty_error: Give the script a name and some content before saving.
page.custom_script.disclaimer: This analysis reduces risk but never guarantees a script is safe.
page.custom_script.defender_unavailable: Windows Defender not found on this PC: only the heuristic analysis could run.
page.custom_script.defender_not_clean: Windows Defender did not confirm this script is clean.
page.custom_script.ahk_missing_text: The AutoHotkey interpreter bundled with the app is missing or damaged (file deleted or a corrupted copy). Reinstall the app to restore it.
page.custom_script.warn_not_analyzed: This script must be (re)analyzed before it can be launched.
page.custom_script.warn_moderate: This script contains potentially sensitive actions (files, registry, network...). Do you really want to launch it?
page.custom_script.warn_severe: This script was classified as high risk (e.g. download-then-run, or flagged by the antivirus scan). Running it could damage your system or install unwanted software.
page.custom_script.launch_failed: Could not launch this script (AutoHotkey not found or a launch error occurred).
page.custom_script.stop_failed: Could not confirm the script stopped — check Task Manager.
script_security.finding.registry: Windows registry write or delete detected.
script_security.finding.persistence: Access to an auto-start location detected.
script_security.finding.download_then_ru: Download followed by execution of the downloaded file — high-risk combination.
